Multiple headlines highlighted the stock's significant decline and the importance of the July 16th Starship launch attempt.
drivers: Starship test tonight (July 16) uncertainty
SpaceX stock down 48% from peak
$116B lock-up expiry ahead
en.why_matters: The Starship test is crucial for SpaceX's future valuation and operational milestones, impacting investor confidence and market perception of its long-term growth prospects.
en.bull_case: A successful Starship launch tonight could ignite a significant short squeeze, pushing SPCX above $110.
en.bear_case: A failed Starship test or heavy selling from the $116B lock-up could easily keep SPCX below $110.

zh.title: SpaceX股价因测试承压
zh.summary: SpaceX股价在7月底收盘高于110美元的概率下降11.7%至52%，主要受今晚关键星舰测试前的投资者焦虑和即将到来的巨额解禁担忧驱动。多篇报道强调了股价的大幅下跌以及7月16日星舰发射尝试的重要性。
drivers: 今晚（7月16日）星舰测试不确定性
SpaceX股价较峰值下跌48%
1160亿美元股票即将解禁
zh.why_matters: 星舰测试对SpaceX的未来估值和运营里程碑至关重要，将影响投资者信心及其长期增长的市场看法。
zh.bull_case: 今晚星舰发射成功可能引发大规模逼空，推动SPCX股价突破110美元。
zh.bear_case: 星舰测试失败或1160亿美元解禁抛售可能使SPCX股价远低于110美元。
